## Frosthaven — Section 67.1

**Title:** "Life and Death" (conclusion of Scenario 61)
**Source:** Frosthaven Section Book, pp. 67

> Your ears fill with the sound of your own breathing: heavy, stinging, rib-pulling breaths. Your legs are full of acid, ready to seize, but you push through the pain and exhaustion, struggling to keep up with Moonshard…

The full narrative describes the party escaping a terror-filled cave with the help of Moonshard, meeting an ancient Orchid named **Terra** around a campfire, and learning about **the Harbinger** — a bound entity whose escape the group must prevent. Terra introduces the **Shattersong**, a lineage of quartz Savvas uniquely attuned to the Harbinger's malice.

## Are They the Same Section?

**No, they are entirely different.** The only thing they share is the number "67.1." They belong to separate games, separate scenarios, and are different in every other respect:

- The **Frosthaven** section is a **narrative conclusion** to Scenario 61 ("Life and Death"), with story text, named characters, and campaign rewards.
- The **Gloomhaven (2nd Edition)** section is a **structured monster-placement section** for Room 6 of Scenario 55 ("The Last Stand"), with no narrative text — only encounter setup data.

Section numbers are not shared or coordinated across the two games.

Both sections have been retrieved. Here is what the verified data shows:

---

**Gloomhaven (2nd Edition) — Section 67.1**

This is a **structured scenario section**, not narrative or rules text. It contains room-setup data for "The Last Stand" (parent scenario 55): monster placement for a 6-room encounter, listing *Black Imp*, *Chaos Demon*, *Deep Terror*, and *Harrower Infester* at various player counts. There is no prose rules text in this section.

---

**Frosthaven — Section 67.1**

This is a **narrative conclusion section** labeled "Life and Death" (linked to scenario 61). It contains story text resolving a cave encounter, introduces characters Terra and Moonshard, and ends with a reward (unlock class box) and a section link (add section 140.3 to the calendar in one week). There is no rules text in this section.

---

**On whether either section can serve as evidence for the other game:**

**No — and the content confirms why.**

- The two sections share only a number. One is a monster-placement data record for a Gloomhaven (2nd Edition) scenario; the other is a Frosthaven campaign narrative conclusion. They address entirely different things and have no overlapping subject matter.
- Section numbers are not shared references across the two games. A section number in one game carries no meaning or authority in the other.
- Neither section contains rules text of any kind, so neither could support a rules argument even within its own game, let alone across games.
